title: About 22 hours from first prompt to a submitted jam game, directing AI coding agents in Unreal Engine 5. What worked and what didn’t.
author: overcapacity-studios
selftext:
Two of us entered the 2026 Epic AI MegaJam with **Rest & Vest**, an idle game where a robot vacuum does your job while you coast until your equity vests. Most of the code was written by AI coding agents, and we directed them. Here’s the honest version.

**What worked:**

* **Agents driving the editor.** The agent could compile, start Play-in-Editor, take screenshots and read logs through the editor’s MCP server, so it checked its own UI changes instead of guessing.
* **Agents writing their own test harnesses.** Off-screen capture modes, a stepped 30 fps “demo reel” mode that recorded our gameplay video from a scripted run, rule fuzzers and in-game bots.
* **A second model as a reviewer.** We had a different model (Codex) review the C++ read-only right before the final build. It found six issues; four were real, and we fixed them, including a missing mouse-only path to the pause menu and an int overflow in an end-of-quarter bonus.
* **Batch icon generation.** All 57 card and skill icons came from one style sheet plus a pilot batch, then parallel runs, with a look check at the end.

**What didn’t:**

* Agents testing in conditions players don’t have. Every bug players reported lived where the automated tests couldn’t reach, like windowed mode or text shimmer.
* Packaging traps. If the game was running from the output folder, the build still said “BUILD SUCCESSFUL” but kept the old exe. You have to check that yourself.
* Taste. The agents happily shipped glowing, blown-out highlights. Every visual call came from us.

Game (free, Windows): [https://overcapacity-studios.itch.io/rest-and-vest](https://overcapacity-studios.itch.io/rest-and-vest) Full timeline from first prompt to submission: [https://overcapacity-studios.itch.io/rest-and-vest/devlog/1781042/how-rest-vest-was-built-from-first-prompt-to-submission-in-22-hours](https://overcapacity-studios.itch.io/rest-and-vest/devlog/1781042/how-rest-vest-was-built-from-first-prompt-to-submission-in-22-hours)

**Notes:** for r/ClaudeAI, open with the Claude Code workflow (MCP into the editor, the handoff notes between sessions) and put the Codex review second.
